description: Inputs supplied by the client release and production-promotion workflows, not application configuration.

CLI_VERSION.description: Exact published CLI version installed by the isolated production consumer. Required for production-smoke.mjs.

SDK_VERSION.description: Independent exact published SDK version installed by the isolated production consumer. Required for production-smoke.mjs.

RELEASE_WORKFLOW_ID.description: Release workflow identity from the successful workflow_run event, used to authenticate retained candidate receipts. Required for promote-npm.py select.

V.description: Smoke-verified CLI version supplied to promote-npm.py promote and the Homebrew formula step.

S.description: Smoke-verified independent SDK version supplied to promote-npm.py promote.

TAG.description: Existing immutable release tag selected by the Release workflow. The candidate producer requires it to equal v followed by the source CLI version.
